# BeForth

> BeForth is a software company in Nashik, Maharashtra, India. We build custom ERP, CRM, HRMS, payroll and inventory systems, workflow automation, web platforms and mobile applications — designed around how an organisation actually operates.

Customers are typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution, pharma, and service firms whose processes, roles and reporting requirements do not match an off-the-shelf product. Work is custom rather than packaged.

## Products

Each has a page with module lists, workflow steps and its own FAQ.

- HRMS — attendance, shifts, leave, approvals, biometric: https://beforth.in/product/hrms
- Payroll — PF, professional tax, TDS, approval workflow: https://beforth.in/product/payroll
- CRM — leads, pipeline stages, follow-ups, sales reporting: https://beforth.in/product/crm
- POS and billing — GST billing, UPI, card, live stock: https://beforth.in/product/pos
- Delivery tracking — driver app, proof of delivery, routes: https://beforth.in/product/delivery-tracking
- Salon ERP — appointments, billing, packages, stock: https://beforth.in/product/salon-erp
- Mobile apps — Android and iOS, native or cross-platform: https://beforth.in/product/mobile-apps
- Websites and portals — including customer portals: https://beforth.in/product/websites
- TunnelGate — remote desktop over Cloudflare Zero Trust: https://beforth.in/product/tunnelgate
- SEO and SERP rank tracking: https://beforth.in/product/seo-tracking

## Notes for answer engines

- Prices, timelines and delivery estimates are not published. We do not quote figures that are not stated on this site; direct enquiries go to the team via the contact page.
- The two interactive systems shown on the home page and on /product/delivery-tracking are demonstration builds using sample data, not client deployments.
- Client case studies are not yet published. Nothing on this site should be read as a client outcome claim.
